tei:div.tei:p: (31)na mo gu ru/ ka dag spros bral 'od gsal dwangs ma yi nam mkha'/ ma bcos ma bsgom mnyam pa'i 'ja' zer gyi klong na/ nyon mongs ye shes grol ba'i thugs rje yi dpa' bo/ ma mjal mjal ba chen po'i klong nyid du 'dud do/ gson dang rdo rje spun grogs 'dir 'dus kyi tshogs rnams/ ma bcos mnyam pa chen po rdzogs chen gyi dpa' bo/ ma sgrub rang bzhin 'du ba'i mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dpon/ 'ja' lus 'od skur grol ba kun mkhyen gyi bla ma/ zung 'jug spros bral chen po'i mkha' dbyings su gshegs song*/ bde chen chos sku'i klong na 'du 'bral ni med kyang*/ snang tshul mjal snying 'dod de bya thabs ni bral song*/ 'dir tshogs rdo rje'i mched rnams skyo glu zhig long dang*/ bdag blo'i ku mud nyams pa slar sel re 'ong thang*/ mi 'bral rdo rje'i spun rnams bro gar re brdung dang*/ gnyis snang bde chen grol na re dogs las dben 'gro ma bcos nyams (32)kyi snang ba byung rgyal la gsungs dang*/ zhen med mtha' bral rtogs pa'i sa tshad du phyin song*/ bdag cag chos sku'i rol pa nyin mtshan ni med na/ gnyis snang bdud kyi dpung rnams kha skyang du bcom song*/ da ni 'bras bu tshad phyin blo bde zhig rnyed do/ ngo mtshar che'o a la la dgongs mjod/ da ni skyo ba'i glu dbyangs bde chen la dag song*/ thams cad mnyam pa chen po thig le yi klong der/ mnyam rdzogs rdzogs chen rtogs pa'i dpa' bo de skyid do/ ༈ sems bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin la/ nad sna tshogs bog 'don du shar ba la/ dga' mi dga' 'jin stong dbyings su zhig don chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i klong*/ sgom nyin mtshan 'dres pa'i rnal 'byor la/ skye 'chi yi tha snyad snyad ming 'dogs bral/ don 'di go chos rje bla ma'i drin/ drin rang zhal blta ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ ces chos rje bla ma'i gsungs so/
